statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The associated symptom code R42 (dizziness) was used
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
Continuous ambulatory monitoring was clinically indicated to detect intermittent arrhythmic events
